title: Torus-Holonomy Obstructions, Complex-vs-Real Signing Dichotomies, and Clifford-Cube Lifting Beyond Huang
abstract: Huang's proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture rests on constructing a real +-1 signing S of the hypercube Q_n satisfying S^2 = n I. We determine exact topological, algebraic, and spectral boundaries for extending Huang-optimal signings S^2 = d I (both real symmetric and complex Hermitian with unit-modulus edge weights |S_{xy}| = 1) to general d-regular graphs and their Cartesian products. First, we prove a universal complex torus-holonomy no-go theorem: for any two non-bipartite regular graphs G and H, no Hermitian unit-modulus signing S of G box H — even over all of C — satisfies S^2 = (d_G + d_H) I. Every odd-cycle discrete torus C_{2a+1} box C_{2b+1} in G box H forces the product of its (2a+1)(2b+1) elementary 4-cycle holonomies to equal both (-1)^((2a+1)(2b+1)) = -1 and +1 (since every edge cancels via S_{xy} conj(S_{xy}) = |S_{xy}|^2 = 1). For real +-1 signings, v elementary-4-cycle-disjoint odd-cycle tori enforce the quantitative Frobenius defect ||S^2 - d I||_F^2 >= 8v. On H(2,3) = K_3 box K_3, exhaustive zero-float Faddeev-LeVerrier and Sturm isolation across all 2^10 = 1,024 real switching classes (43 distinct spectra) certifies min ||S||_op = (1 + sqrt(17))/2 > 2 = sqrt(4) (exact characteristic polynomial x(x^4 - 9x^2 + 16)^2), max lambda_5(S) = 1 < 2 (factor-2 collapse on 5-vertex interlacing), and max lambda_4(S) = 2 (attained by -A at ||S||_op = 4). Second, we prove a sharp complex-vs-real signing dichotomy on complete graphs K_q: real symmetric +-1 signings S^2 = (q-1)I_q force q === 2 (mod 4) (symmetric conference matrices), ruling out all odd q and all q === 0 (mod 4), whereas purely imaginary Hermitian signings H_q = i A_q in {0, +-i}^{q x q} from skew-Hadamard matrices achieve H_q^2 = (q-1)I_q across q in {4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, ...}. Furthermore, the block-Clifford lift S_{k+1} = [[S_k, I], [I, -S_k]] preserves S_k^2 = (d_0 + k) I along G_0 box Q_n without requiring G_0 to be bipartite, proving Delta((G_0 box Q_n)[U]) >= ceil(sqrt(d_0 + n)) for every induced subgraph with |U| > |V|/2 across infinite non-bipartite families seeded by conference, skew-Hadamard, and octahedron graphs. Third, we present an exhaustive zero-float switching-class atlas across 11 canonical regular graphs separating all 4 real Huang-optimal cases from 7 obstructed graphs. A two-layer verification artifact accompanies the paper: 20 constructive, axiom-free Lean 4.36.0 theorems formalizing the parity, modular, lifting, and Sturm-isolation arithmetic kernel, paired with 16 zero-float Python certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
